project.name: Tabboz Simulator — Windows native modernization
project.summary: Port the original C game to Windows 10/11 with a modern native interface and installer, preserving gameplay.

milestones.title: Original assessment and reviewed native Windows design
Native x64 application with conserved gameplay and updated interface
Installer, portable package, and Windows validation

decisions.title: Native C/Win32, preserved economy, modern euro UI and safe persistence

frozen_invariants: Retain original C gameplay rules, economy, events, activity outcomes, original character assets, and tone.
Deliver a native Windows application and installer, preserving upstream attribution and GPL-3.0-or-later licensing.
The user selected C with modernized native Windows controls on 2026-10-29.
Euros are the default currency with cents; preserve the original internal-unit conversion and economy.

known_issues.title: Windows 10 actual runtime not tested; target minimum 1903 x64 validated statically
Physical multi-monitor DPI transitions not tested; simulated main-window layouts verified
Original phone affordability arithmetic can underflow unsigned money; complete uint32 persistence is preserved without altering gameplay rules

do_not_redo: Upstream source is already cloned locally; reuse it and its pinned commit.
REA original PE resource analysis is retained in docs/research; do not repeat it without a new question.
MSVC 2022, Windows SDK, and CMake exist on the Windows host; do not install duplicate toolchains.
